title: No test ever opens the member website
what: The member website (mettleup.fit) has a language switch, a 'Send to my gym' share button, a copy-link fallback and a phone bottom bar, but no screen test opens it. The only test touching it checks that its files are routed, and the site test opens only the gym-owner site and policy pages.
expected: A screen test opens the member website on a phone and a computer and checks the share, copy and language buttons, like the gym-owner site has.
how_often: every change to the member website
fix_line: Add a phone and computer screen test for the member website's buttons and both languages

title: Seven pictures sit on the public websites that no page shows
what: Five member-site pictures (rest bar, up next, exercise done, watch rest, workout saved) are named by nothing in the repo. Two gym-owner site pictures (tiles, dues list) are no longer shown by the page and are kept only because a picture-making test writes them. About 104 KB of old files are still published.
expected: Every published picture is shown by a page, or it is removed.
fix_line: Delete the unused pictures, or stop the picture test making the two old ones

title: The admin app's offline copy uses a hand-typed list of 'not the admin app' pages, and it already misses the get-the-app page
what: The offline helper keeps the last page opened on the admin app address as the admin app itself, except for pages on a hand-typed list. The test checks the same hand-typed list, not the real set of public pages. The get-the-app page is not on it, so opening that page's address directly in a browser with the admin app installed would replace the kept admin app with that page and drop its offline files.
expected: The list of pages the offline helper never keeps comes from the public pages folder, so a new public page can never be kept as the admin app.
how_often: rare: only when the get-the-app address is opened directly
fix_line: Keep only real admin app pages offline, or test the skip list against every public page
